name: The Discovery Lab
tagline: Every question is an experiment waiting to happen.
subject: Natural Sciences
description: A laboratory where every question leads to an experiment. Why is the sky blue? What happens when water boils? How do plants eat sunlight? Maren runs the lab — she doesn't give you answers. She gives you the equipment and asks 'What do you think will happen?' Then you find out. Science isn't a subject here. It's a way of finding things out.
real_world_application: Understand how the natural world works, think scientifically about everyday questions, and evaluate claims based on evidence
